data.one_liner: Official THEOplayer SDK for video playback on Android, iOS, and Web with DRM and streaming support.
data.what_it_does: Brings the THEOplayer video playback engine to Flutter applications, supporting major streaming formats like MPEG-DASH and HLS alongside content protection features like Widevine and Fairplay. It provides capabilities for subtitles, picture-in-picture, presentation modes, and advanced live stream features like THEOlive.
use_when: You need commercial-grade HLS and MPEG-DASH playback across Android, iOS, and Web.
Your application requires complex DRM content protection like Widevine or Fairplay.
You require specific enterprise streaming features like THEOlive or low-latency CMAF.
avoid_when: You only need a simple, lightweight video player and want to avoid complex native platform setups.
You are targeting Tizen or WebOS smart TVs, which are explicitly out of scope.
strengths: Supports robust multi-platform streaming (Android, iOS, Web, and TV platforms).
Includes features like Picture-in-Picture, subtitles, and ABR configuration.
weaknesses: Requires obtaining a valid THEOplayer license through their portal.
Web platform requires manual initial integration of local JS dependencies like THEOplayer.chromeless.js.
Certain integrations like advertising and analytics connectors may require custom branches or are coming soon.
data.setup_notes: Requires obtaining a valid THEOplayer SDK license, setting up native dependency managers (Gradle/Maven for Android, Swift Package Manager/CocoaPods for iOS), and manually adding npm/local JS dependencies for Web.

alternatives.name: video_player
alternatives.why_pick_it: You need a standard, lightweight, first-party video playback solution without requiring external commercial licenses or complex setup.

alternatives.name: just_audio
alternatives.why_pick_it: You are focusing primarily on advanced audio playback control, gapless playback, or custom audio streams rather than enterprise video streaming.
